fields.spec_version: Low Pin Count (LPC) Interface Specification Revision 1.1 (Intel, August 2002)

lineage.summary: Legacy parallel expansion bus that LPC replaces.
First Low Pin Count interface specification.
Adds firmware memory cycles and clarifications; the current base spec.

backward_compat_traps.rule: LPC is the PARALLEL predecessor — a 4-bit LAD[3:0] multiplexed bus framed by LFRAME#; it has NO logical channels, NO opcode table, NO CRC, NO GET/SET configuration.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating LPC as if it had eSPI's four channels / CRC / negotiation is wrong.

backward_compat_traps.rule: LPC reuses the 33 MHz PCI clock as LCLK and shares PCI RST# as LRESET#; it adds no new clock pin.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Assuming LPC has its own independent clock domain misses the PCI-clock reuse intent.
